unitOfObservation: source rule record; not a parcel or unique district
eligibility: housing type allowed, allowed/conditional or hearing; exclude explicitly overlay or extinct records
numericDefinition: nonnegative literal whole or decimal number with source field unit or recognized companion unit/value-kind; formulas and spreadsheet dates excluded
recordedDefinition: numeric + explicitNone + other; excludes notApplicable, missing and absent
combinationDefinition: intersection of fields in the same record and housing type; height must be positive; capacity is density OR units per building; multifamily parking requires both bedroom fields
